verdict.rationale: JumpCloud is an identity and directory platform, so scheduled access certification campaigns are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions access reviews, certification campaigns, reviewer routing, or sign-off records. The nearest items are adjacent: Graph API traversal of bindings, Directory Insights event logs, and lifecycle automation. These are developer building blocks or related features, not a review-campaign capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
